_comment: Tickers to collect AFFO-per-share (or Core FFO / FFO-as-adjusted per share) for -- the equity-REIT subset of advisor_universe.json, not the whole universe, for the same reason operating_kpi_universe.json scopes to retail/restaurants: spending the SEC rate-limit budget on companies whose releases never state this figure at all. Derived once from public/data/advisor.json's screen_universe sector/industry classification (2026-08-27 snapshot) for the Yahoo industries REIT - Diversified/Healthcare Facilities/Hotel & Motel/Industrial/Office/Residential/Retail/Specialty. Mortgage REITs (REIT - Mortgage) are deliberately excluded: they hold and trade debt/MBS instruments rather than operating physical property, so they do not report FFO/AFFO/Core-FFO at all -- their analogous disclosures (book value per share, net interest margin) are a different metric family this module does not attempt. A company's sector/industry classification changes rarely enough that this list does not need to be regenerated every run; regenerate by re-filtering a fresh screen_universe snapshot on the same industry set if it drifts.
